title: MB loyihalash: research platform for controlled studies of generative-AI support in database design education (verification scripts and data)
description:
Source code of the «MB loyihalash» web platform for entity–relationship (ER), SQL and normalization laboratories, which controls large-language-model (LLM) support as an experimental condition, records the modeling process and computes the trial statistics.

The research/texnik-tekshiruv/ folder contains the verification scripts, raw logs and simulation output reported in the accompanying manuscript: scripted synthetic learners with a known null effect (condition isolation, process-log fidelity, null calibration of the analytics, load tests with 12–65 concurrent accounts) and a replicated simulation of the platform's statistical functions (R = 2,000 per condition; takroriy_simulyatsiya.py). All data are synthetic; no human participants or personal data are included.
